propositions: Snapshot store garbage collection runs only in the review-bot process; every other host that resolves attested gates populates the store without reclaiming, causing unbounded growth (measured: 64,021 entries, 47.24 GiB on one dev host).

An operation-linked GC trigger must be added to the gate-resolution path that avoids long-lock pitfalls by using a near-free O(1) in-process check followed by detached GC work outside any ticket-store lock.

The trigger implementation must mirror the compaction-sweep pattern: stamp/lock sidecars keyed on the snapshot store root, one stat-based cadence check, and a detached child process running the existing janitor policy under its own flock.

Single-flight semantics across simultaneous hosts and worktrees must be enforced via a stamped worker-lock sidecar, with overlap against the review-bot's resident janitor gracefully degrading to skipped="locked".
